did: The manual extension-signing workflow no longer runs the extension name you type as shell code: it arrives as data and must name an extension the repository has, and a test that reads the workflow as YAML holds that on every pull request (WS1, #2952). The assurance page now shows the render image's byte proof as a check on template previews, named for what it really proves: the weekly call's preview rendered twice, with no voices, must match (#2960). A new test fails whenever a recorder opens a page the render image's stage doesn't serve (RI2, #2962). And the recorder now says `cache hit:` for each render step it takes from the cache, so a resumed render on home shows what it didn't redo (#2965). Along the way, a slow www test that timed out whenever every package's tests ran together was filed as #2956 and fixed by the coordinator's #2958.
left: #2116 steps 2–4 stay open: the other high zizmor findings, running zizmor and actionlint in CI (a draft is on claude/queue-u8-workflow-security), and re-measuring the baseline; the owner's question whether to hash-pin every uses: ref is still unanswered there.

server#739: home's render image has to be bumped to a commit with #2965 before a resumed render on home shows cache-hit lines, and part 3 (a sign of life while rendering) is server work; both need a server session.

#2888 said the image proof checks all four templates against the full www build; it checks only the weekly call's preview, twice. Covering the others would be a workflow change, noted on #2888 and not filed.
